node_rule: h_i=min(length of previous and next actual interface edges)
segment_rule: exact nearest closed segment, linear interpolation of endpoint h_i at projected position
outside: d>=1c returns h_old exactly; midpoint broad-phase cannot skip a segment with true d<1c

distance_audit.reference: Brute-force distance/projection to EVERY real interface segment, independent of cKDTree candidate selection
distance_audit.broad_phase_completeness: midpoint lower bound and candidate radius use maximum actual segment half-length, with2e-12m roundoff padding
